newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK K&P International says IPO 13 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK K&P International says IPO 13 times subscribed.

text.p: Hong Kong electronics firm K&P International Holdings Ltd said on Friday its initial public offering (IPO) of 55 million new shares was 13.1 times subscribed.
Dealing in the company shares is due to begin on January 2.
K&P offered 55 million new shares at HK$1.00 each with one warrant to be issued for every five shares.
The company makes conductive silicone rubber keypads, electronic calculators, alarm clocks and plastic products.

It said the net proceeds of the issue would be used to build a new factory in China, acquire additional machinery and support the group's vertical diversification into the production of alarm clock components.
